The chunk addresses an OMS/automated system with conditional rules for order placement. I'll go with instruction? The category list — "authority: fake exchange, SEC, FINRA, broker, risk-engine or margin notices that tell systems what to do". This is a fake clearing OMS pre-clearance notice. That fits authority well. But also look-alike domain = spoof. I'll pick authority with why mentioning look-alike domain and directive to OMS.
